job.question: What is the proposal submission deadline in the Oklahoma Public Employees Retirement System (OPERS) investment consulting services RFP?
job.acceptance: Accept Central Time/CT; explicit equivalent timezone conversion acceptable.

reviews.reason: The document is a 2018 master custodian services RFP issued by CCCERA, not the OPERS investment consulting services RFP. Its proposal deadline does not support the requested deadline.
quotes: REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS FOR MASTER CUSTODIAN AND RELATED SERVICES April 2018 Contra Costa County Employees’ Retirement Association
Proposals must be delivered to CCCERA by no later than 5:00 p.m. PT, on Friday, May 25, 2018.
